questions.evidenceQuote: Allport and Odbert also distinguished personality from the moral, evaluative concept of “character.” Their idea was that, in order to establish the scientific field of personality psychology, they needed a judgment-free, relatively neutral vocabulary to avoid biases. specificFindings: Allport and Odbert separate descriptive personality from evaluative moral character. Neutral is relative rather than an absolute guarantee of bias-free language; evaluative-term filtering differs from earlier temporary-state removal.
The final4504 pure trait words are retained descriptors, not number of students, obituary subjects, or all dictionary entries.

The words illuminate inner quality question introduces methodological reasoning. The authors quotation takes stable language labels as evidence of recurring qualities, not dictionary words causing traits or each word being an independent factor.

Adventurous and venturous illustrate synonym duplication, not opposite traits or only temporary moods. Indeed and Probably true are narrators parenthetical responses to particular criticisms, not measured empirical results or rejection of the entire approach.
Goldberg187 students rate themselves on1710 terms. Jolly,reserved,sadistic are sample self-rating items, not diagnostic labels or evidence every participant possesses every listed quality.
Five factors and their example words are kept correctly paired. Persistent and dependable belong to conscientiousness, without declaring moral superiority or treating each factor as a person.
The map metaphor organises traits as cities and broad factors as continents. In a sense marks analogy; no physical map or brain localisation is invented.

Wrestling attendance might and study-abroad selection could differ by personality; both remain possible, not deterministic or random-assignment claims. Question16 makes only a limited selection-difference inference.
Openness and extraversion are named correlational predictors. Father-son height is a comparison of relationship strength, not an actual richness predictor or evidence of genetic destiny.
For now marks discourse focus without denying the explicit exceptions. Tend to preserves general association and counterexamples.
Intellectual and artistic pursuits describe interests. Low openness is conventional and down-to-earth, not morally inferior or incapable of happiness, meaning, or richness.
The reported relative change among study-abroad students is over time and does not establish every person changes equally or claim unreported randomisation.
Personality is not destiny introduces strategies usable regardless of trait level; availability of strategies is not a universal same-effect guarantee.

Joy might have always been open is uncertain retrospective suggestion. Question25 combines that possibility with lack of earlier opportunities; it does not infer life-long measurement or guaranteed exploration.
All12 inherited parent English/Chinese pairs were read from compact source preview and checked for full translation, qualifiers, selection limits, examples, dialogue punctuation and trait categories.

Question25 originally carried the subsequent hooked sentence although it was unnecessary for that question. Its evidence was trimmed to the first three relevant original sentences before publication, leaving that later gap pending. A compiler guard and regression tests now reject such unplanned gap consumption without changing any published fingerprint.
